en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a panoramic view of a town nestled amongst rocky hills and greenery. Prominent buildings, including what appears to be institutional and industrial architectures, are visible in the foreground. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'Uddevalla, Utsigt från Kålgårdsberget.' There is also a date, 'Febr. 1903', and credits to a local photography studio or shop. There is a watermark for 'Uddevalla Museum.'
